questions.question: What is phishing, and how does it work?
options: A. A legitimate way to reset your password
B. A cyber attack where attackers trick users into revealing sensitive information
C. A way to speed up internet connections
D. A secure method to log in to websites

questions.question: How can you identify a phishing email?
options: A. It may contain urgent or threatening language
B. It always comes from a known sender
C. It only contains plain text with no links
D. It is always safe if it has a company logo

questions.question: Why should you never click on suspicious links in emails or messages?
options: A. They may redirect you to a malicious website
B. They can automatically install malware on your device
C. They can steal your personal information
D. All of the above

questions.question: How can you verify the legitimacy of a website before entering your credentials?
options: A. Check for spelling errors in the URL
B. Look for HTTPS and a padlock symbol
C. Search the website's reputation online
D. All of the above

questions.question: What role does HTTPS play in determining if a website is safe?
options: A. It ensures that the website is 100% safe from phishing
B. It encrypts data between you and the website
C. It guarantees that the website is owned by a trusted company
D. It prevents all types of cyber attacks

questions.question: How can you recognize a phishing attempt through social media messages?
options: A. The message contains urgent requests for personal information
B. The sender's profile looks suspicious or newly created
C. The message contains unusual links or attachments
D. All of the above

questions.question: What are the dangers of downloading attachments from unknown emails?
options: A. The attachment may contain malware or viruses
B. It can delete files from your computer
C. It may track your keystrokes and steal passwords
D. All of the above

questions.question: Why should you enable two-factor authentication (2FA) on your accounts?
options: A. It makes logging in faster
B. It adds an extra layer of security even if your password is compromised
C. It eliminates the need for strong passwords
D. It only works on banking websites

questions.question: What are some common red flags of a phishing scam?
options: A. Poor grammar and spelling mistakes
B. Requests for sensitive information
C. Unexpected email attachments or links
D. All of the above

questions.question: How does phishing through phone calls (vishing) work, and how can you protect yourself?
options: A. Attackers pretend to be from legitimate organizations to get your information
B. Always verify the caller's identity before sharing sensitive details
C. Do not trust unsolicited calls asking for financial details
D. All of the above

questions.question: Why is it important to keep your software and antivirus programs up to date?
options: A. It helps protect against new phishing techniques
B. It speeds up your computer
C. It prevents pop-up ads
D. It stops all types of cyber attacks

questions.question: How can you report phishing attempts to the authorities or your organization?
options: A. Forward the email or message to the company's official fraud department
B. Use built-in email reporting tools for phishing
C. Report the scam to cybersecurity authorities
D. All of the above

questions.question: What should you do if you accidentally fall for a phishing scam?
options: A. Change your passwords immediately
B. Report the incident to your bank or IT department
C. Monitor your accounts for suspicious activity
D. All of the above

questions.question: How can you educate others about phishing scams and prevention?
options: A. Share knowledge about phishing risks with friends and family
B. Conduct security awareness training at workplaces
C. Report phishing attempts to raise awareness
D. All of the above

questions.question: Why is it important to use strong, unique passwords for different accounts?
options: A. It helps protect against credential stuffing attacks
B. It makes it easier to remember passwords
C. It ensures no one else can guess your password
D. It makes logging in faster
